valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest period both the income statement and the balance sheet cover is the interim Q2 2026, whose flows cover only part of a year and are not annualised, so a market multiple built on them would not be a year's multiple. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: no positive earnings growth is on file, so P/E over growth cannot be built.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.peEpsSource: the filed earnings-per-share row for FY2025
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2025
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2025
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.peRouteNote: P/E reproduced from the market capitalisation on file (100000000000) and the net profit for FY2025
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest period both the income statement and the balance sheet cover is the interim Q2 2026, whose flows cover only part of a year and are not annualised, so a market multiple built on them would not be a year's multiple. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: total equity is not on file for Q2 2026, so a P/B cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest period both the income statement and the balance sheet cover is the interim Q2 2026, whose flows cover only part of a year and are not annualised, so a market multiple built on them would not be a year's multiple.
